key_features: Take the worries out of packing for the first day of school with this essential twenty (20) piece kit. This back to school bundle contains everything your elementary student needs to start their first day of kindergarten, first grade, second grade, third grade, or forth.

This essential kit contains first day basics including (1) 24pk of crayons, (1) 12pk of color pencils, (1) 10pk of washable markers, (1) glue bottle, (2) glue sticks, (2) classic pink erasers, (1) 8pk of pencils, and (1) 5" blunt tip scissors, (1) 12-inch wooden ruler, and (1) pencil box.

Organization is important. That's why this bundle also includes (1) 1-inch binder and (2) 3-prong folders. Write down your class notes your (2) wide-ruled composition books, (2) single-subject wide-ruled notebooks.

Stop waiting for the school supply list from your child's school and get ahead of the game with this essential bundle. Grab one as a gift for your son, daughter, niece, nephew, grandson, granddaughter, or even a few the teacher in your family.

Whether you're trying to get ahead for next year or you're a first time parent getting ready for your child's big first day at school, this essential school supply bundle will take the hassle out of back to school shopping.
review_summary: Every parent has experienced the frustration of buying school supplies. Crowds and limited supplies at box stores can make it impossible to find everything on your child's school supply list quickly. Shopping early might help, but who wants to shop for school supplies in July? And if you’re one of those last minute shoppers, you often have to take what you can find no matter if it might not be the best quality. We saw this and thought there had to be a better way.
